independence.inputs: Current dist artifacts, README, docs/BUILDING, build/cache/gate source, gate status and repository tests only. Gate internals read its machine evidence as explicitly permitted.
independence.mutations: Only own report/scratch outputs; no dist build or font/source edits.

tests.name: artifact metadata and manifest
tests.details: TTF 311328 B; WOFF2 93320 B (91.13 KiB); 218 glyphs; 189 encoded characters exactly matching declared charset; both cmap equal; version 0.0.3; axes wght 100/400/900 and opsz 9/14/128; nine named instances.

tests.name: feature declarations
tests.details: GSUB calt/liga/pnum/tnum; GPOS kern present. Functional shaping not assessed here.

tests.name: cache fingerprints
tests.details: All nine discovered versioned font/CSS/JS references match current payload digests.

tests.name: gate/cache regression tests
tests.details: PYTHONPATH=scripts .venv/bin/python -m unittest scripts.test_web_cache font_recovery.test_design_status: 8 passed. Initial invocation lacked scripts import path; corrected invocation passed.

tests.name: README consistency
tests.details: Coverage, sizes, axes, features, nine instances and version match binaries. README explicitly labels pilot status and incomplete participant/platform evaluation.

tests.name: build-source inspection
tests.details: Main builder generates UFO sources via local geometry modules and local source JSON; no direct SFNS/Inter reads observed. build-web compiles, checks digits/timers and refreshes caches. Full dependency/provenance audit and reproducible rebuild excluded.

findings.condition: Current authorial release gate rejects this exact TTF: all D01–D06 pending and authorial deviations unverified. Technical and numeric audit failure arrays are empty; baseline criterion has 160 cases below 95% across 37 characters.
findings.recommendation: Retain pilot-only positioning and complete exact-hash decision evidence before promoting an authorial-ready release. Do not equate raster similarity with reading performance.
findings.acceptance_test: python -m font_recovery.design_status --require authorial exits 0 for this exact approved artifact, with complete hashed evidence and no pending decisions.

limits: No font rebuild performed; reproducibility unverified independently.
No human testing, Apple endorsement, visual/readability or full platform certification.
Gate readiness is an engineering/project decision criterion, not a reading-outcome measure.
Main build-source inspection does not prove entire dependency-chain provenance.
